title: 3.5 stars
text:
3.5 stars. Perfect size and height for a foot stall. It’s not bulky looking and in design. Very comfortable to use. However: I get that you get what you pay for. Hence, you aren’t gonna get. Polished finished product. The legs were okay although the vanishing was little haphazard in places and since I got the darker wood, you can not see it unless you lift it up to your face, which I wouldn’t be doing; no instructions [here is my quick summary: the silver screws with the circle is for screwing the legs to the stool top; the gold ones are for the side panels to the legs; make sure the two circles are facing INWARDS; and don’t tighten everything until all the screws and wooden bolts are loosely in place]; and then my Allen key snapped when screwing the gold screws in- thankfully, I keep a few spare ones. An extra screw part is included in the pack.
The cover has a slight plastic protection on it - so wash with cold water. I will likely to make my own cover to replace the original one, although the original one is fine too. The cover is elasticated so very easy to slip on and off. There is a spongy cushion beneath the cover, which makes it very comfortable for the feet.

Okay for little kids [under 7], don’t recommend for adults and not for standing on.

The price point, it is functional for what we need without creating a bulky look.
